children: has reported elevated conversation errors affecting ChatGPT users on several subscription plans, including Plus, Pro, Business, Team, and Education, according to the company's official status page.
The issue was reported on November 25, with OpenAI
saying it had identified the problem and was working on implementing a mitigation. The affected component was ChatGPT's Conversations service.
The disruption also extends beyond standard ChatGPT conversations. OpenAI's
latest status-page update identifies elevated errors impacting ChatGPT Work and cloud-based Codex threads.

OpenAI has not disclosed the root cause, the number of affected users, or an estimated timeline for full-service restoration. The incident remained listed as identified, with degraded performance, in the latest official update reviewed. It could prevent users from sending messages, starting conversations, or receiving responses normally.
did not immediately respond to Seeking Alpha's request for comment.
The latest incident follows another disruption on November 23, when OpenAI reported elevated errors affecting GPT-6 conversations on paid ChatGPT plans.

title: OpenAI says ChatGPT faces elevated conversation errors
